diagrams.title: Two agents, one shared memory
diagrams.caption: Two agents, one shared memory. The interviewer never grades and the evaluator never chooses questions. Each has one job, and the session log is the only thing they pass between them.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 900 214" aria-label="Multi-agent loop.
